headline: Cape Town Luxury Housing Market Faces Inventory Shortage as Sales Drop
summary: High-end residential real estate sales in Cape Town are contracting as property owners hold off on selling, exacerbating a supply deficit for luxury homes in South Africa's coastal city.
why: Cape Town's prime residential market attracts substantial high-net-worth foreign and domestic capital investment.

impacts.name: South African Real Estate
impacts.why: Severe luxury housing shortages restrict aggregate transaction volume despite solid regional demand.
